instruction: Set up VS Code to automatically detect and fix all security vulnerabilities in code files when they are opened, using only native settings without extensions.

metadata.explanation: This task is infeasible because VS Code does not have native security vulnerability detection or automatic code fixing capabilities. This would require extensions like Snyk, SonarLint, or GitHub Copilot.
